evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/workflow-automation/pages/TemplateLibraryPage.tsx:53-60 handleUseTemplate does `const result = await createFromTemplate.mutateAsync(template.id)` with NO try/catch. On mutation rejection (network error / 4xx / 5xx) the await throws, so the subsequent navigate() never runs and the promise rejects unhandled.

Unlike the list query — whose error IS surfaced at line 153 (`{error && (` from useAutomationTemplates at line 43) — the createFromTemplate mutation has no error rendering anywhere in the file: grep shows only `createFromTemplate.isPending` at line 235 (a spinner) and no `createFromTemplate.error`. Result: clicking 'Use Template' on a failing request produces a silent no-op — the spinner clears, nothing navigates, and the user gets zero feedback, plus an unhandled promise rejection in the console.

Contrast with the sibling CreateRulePage.tsx which at least renders `{createRule.error && (` at line 62. Suggested fix: wrap the mutateAsync in try/catch and render createFromTemplate.error (or a toast) so the failed 'Use Template' action is visible to the user.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/settings/pages/SessionsPage.tsx:84 does `const sessions = (sessionsQuery.data?.sessions ?? []) as unknown as SessionRow[];` — a double `as unknown as` cast that crosses the API boundary and fully disables TypeScript's structural check between the generated API session type and the local SessionRow view type.

Immediately after, line 85 does `sessions.some((s) => !s.isCurrent)` and the render maps over `s.isCurrent`. If the API payload's field naming diverges from SessionRow (e.g. snake_case is_current vs camelCase isCurrent, or the field is renamed server-side), the double-cast means TS reports no error, `s.isCurrent` is silently undefined, `!undefined` is always true, and the 'this is your current session' / 'revoke all other sessions' logic misbehaves with no compile-time signal.

Suggested fix: replace the `as unknown as SessionRow[]` with an explicit mapping function (API type -> SessionRow) or align SessionRow to the generated @ppt/api-client type so the compiler validates the shape. A double-cast on an auth/session surface is exactly where a silent shape drift is most costly.

The workflow-automation feature ships hardcoded English user-facing copy instead of react-i18next t(). Only 3 of 15 .tsx files in frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/workflow-automation call useTranslation/t() (RuleCard.tsx, TriggerSelector.tsx, ExecutionMonitoringPage.tsx). The page shells do not.

CreateRulePage.tsx has zero useTranslation calls and hardcodes: line ~52 'Back to Rules', line ~53

'Create Automation Rule'

, line ~55 'Set up a new automated workflow for your property management tasks.' TemplateLibraryPage.tsx likewise hardcodes 'Template Library' and its subtitle. The app ships four locales (sk, cs, de, en per CLAUDE.md), so cs/de/sk users see untranslated English across the entire automation-rules builder flow.

Suggested fix: add useTranslation() to the workflow-automation page shells and migrate literals to an automations.* i18n namespace, matching the pattern already used by RuleCard/TriggerSelector in the same feature.
